title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono attend the Cannes Film Festival | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono attended the Cannes Film Festival on 15 May 1971.

They had arrived in the French Riviera the previous day, as their films Fly and Apotheosis were being shown at La Quinzaine des Réalisateurs, an independent showcase running alongside the festival.

On this day they relaxed on the beach and dined at La Colombe d’Or in Saint-Paul-de-Vence. They were photographed with actor Jeanne Moreau and director Louis Malle.

In the evening the premiere of Apotheosis took place, after which they hastily left the screening by Richard Dembo, the publicist of La Quinzaine des Réalisateurs. They were driven by their assistant Dan Richter to a Moroccan restaurant where they were interviewed by film critic Amos Vogel.

Following their dinner, Lennon and Ono returned to Cannes for the premiere of the Fly film. Both films were screened again the next day.
